blocker.detail: Rendered image bytes exist only in disposable runtime storage. The connected GitHub interface exposes UTF-8 file writes and inline blob creation but no local-file binary upload parameter, while direct git/curl access from the container cannot resolve GitHub hosts. Therefore no rendered page can be counted as a durable checkpoint in this session.

resume_instructions: Reclaim the production chapter lane at its new generation and remain in redraw_typeset phase from page 1.
Use relay artifact 9696850714 and the accepted translation commit 289e82cdbff610096209de9b5f56192338f4ee9f.
Only increment rendered_pages after each rendered image is durably persisted under projects/mangadistrict-com-title-stupidemic-uncensored/chapters/ch-200c8c840df0/rendered/.

If the next runtime has a binary-capable GitHub/local git upload path, page 1-3 layout decisions in this result may be reproduced, but the ephemeral image bytes themselves must not be assumed recoverable.
